_comment: Impute defaults for the tier_classifier's OPTIONAL multi-sensor fields (amends/48e). Deliberately a SEPARATE file from sensor_schema.json: that schema drives risk_model_v3.joblib's IsolationForest input vector via missing_aware_preprocessing.reading_to_vector(), which is a FIXED dimensionality (2 numbers per sensor) baked into that model at training time -- adding sensors there would silently change that model's input shape and break it. This file only ever feeds TierClassifierModel.predict(), which builds its input from tier_classifier_v3.joblib's own declared `features` list, so it's free to grow independently. required=true sensors are the original 3-sensor-wearable baseline; required=false are the v5 multi-sensor additions a 3-sensor wearable simply won't have.
